messages.subject: imageRename question
parts:
Hello-
I'm testing out camtrapr for the first time and want to make sure I'm understanding imageRename(). When I run ImageRename multiple times on a 'InDir', it doesn't overwrite the photos that have already been renamed ('CopyStatus' = FALSE, which makes sense) but it still shows 'fileExistsAlready' as FALSE for those photos and still shows a message saying that x number of photos are being copied (in the source code it looks like there's supposed to be a different message for these?). Just want to make sure on this since there's some potential to lose data if I'm not using this function correctly!

thanks!
Pete

messages.subject: Re: imageRename question
parts:
Hi Peter, 
that's strange. Don't know what is causing the error. Can you please check with the attached version of imageRename?
Please let me know if you find a way to make this error reproducible. If so, feel free to share your data with me (privately, if you prefer) and I'll fix it. 

In any case, you can rest assured that nothing will be overwritten. The argument overwrite in file.copy (used internally in imageRename) is set to FALSE. 
Best,
Jürgen
